non-blocking: `_landed` takes a `project` parameter and never reads it; the argument at :546 is dead, so a reader cannot tell whether the function is meant to filter by project and silently does not.

non-blocking: the recorded negative control was not re-measured at the reviewed revision — its header line reads `worktree head c15f841e... + mutation` and it reddens 7 of 10 tests, while the head carries 14 tests and the mutation site it names (`change_set.py line 412`) now sits in a rewritten function, so the log does not by itself demonstrate the guard on the new end-bounded window; the red arm that does is logs/revision-red.log.
